svg.title: Build a chain of evidence
svg.desc: A chain connects contrasts.csv to the manuscript. The agent compares recorded and calculated fingerprints, selects the sample contrast, and checks rounding from -31.639627 to -31.6 grams, with interval -74.3 to 11.0 grams. The saved result is real; the outdated manuscript value is illustrative. The abstract, figures, and captions are also checked. Fingerprints are abbreviated.
